text: Task 7 — Separating Touching Coins in an Automated Counting System A manufacturing system counts circular components placed on a tray. Unfortunately, several components are touching each other. A simple threshold produces one connected white region containing multiple touching objects . Counting connected regions directly therefore produces an incorrect count. Your Task Develop a marker-based watershed segmentation pipeline. implementation must follow the stages presented in the manual: Your Preprocessing 1. Thresholding 2. Noise removal 3. Sure-background generation 4. Distance transform 5. Sure-foreground generation 6. Unknown-region generation 7. Marker labeling 8. Watershed transformation 9. Boundary visualization 10. Required Output Display : Original + Threshold + Sure Background + Distance Transform + Sure Foreground + Unknown Region + Final Watershed Finally, visually inspect whether touching coins have been separated. Talha Shahid 71 Page
